# TokenDance

> TokenDance is Tony's independent app studio making small, privacy-first apps for iPhone and Mac. No ads, no tracking, no account with the developer, and none of your data goes to the developer. In every15min, Goldie and Code Buddy your data stays on your device; Speechless sends what you say to the AI services you add, after you agree.

## Apps

- [every15min](https://every15min.tokendance.life/en/): a time log app for iPhone. Write one line about what just happened roughly every 15 minutes; it builds a daily timeline with tags, search and a 24-hour activity map. On-device only, US$1 one-time purchase. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801988119)
- [Goldie](https://goldie.tokendance.life/): epilepsy medication reminders and seizure diary for iPhone, with dose check-ins, days since last seizure, appointment records and an emergency page. No account, no ads, no tracking. It does not diagnose or give treatment advice.
- [Code Buddy](https://tokendance.life/code-buddy/): a menu bar buddy for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Cursor) on the Mac (macOS 14+), published as Code Buddy – Agent Status. Its face shows whether the agent is working, waiting for your approval or done, and the panel shows token usage and estimated spend. Runs locally with no network access and collects no data. Free on the Mac App Store. [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/code-buddy-agent-status/id6825784479) · [Help](https://tokendance.life/code-buddy/) · [Privacy policy](https://tokendance.life/code-buddy/privacy.html)
- [Speechless](https://tokendance.life/speechless/): voice typing for Mac (macOS 14+, free, notarized, [direct download](https://tokendance.life/speechless/#mac)) and iPhone (iOS 17+, published as Speechless: Voice Keyboard once the App Store approves it; it has been submitted). Hold, talk, let go, and the text goes in where the cursor is. It works with the AI service you bring (OpenRouter by default, or OpenAI, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Volcengine Ark, SiliconFlow or another OpenAI-compatible service) with your own API key; what you say goes to the services you added and agreed to. The developer provides no AI service and runs no server. ABC typing works offline and isn't stored, logged or sent. [Help](https://tokendance.life/speechless/#help) · [Privacy policy](https://tokendance.life/speechless/privacy.html)
